card_title: Artist Notes: Structural Hold Brow Gel
summary: Gravity-defying architecture. A clear, industrial-strength gel that laminates brow hairs firmly in place without flaking.
description: The ultimate brow fixative. This transparent formula coats each hair in a high-tension polymer, allowing for extreme vertical styling and all-day hold against sweat and friction.
technical_overview: Offered at $22.0 for 7ml, this KoColor BROW_GEL is expertly formulated with Water, Polyacrylates, and Panthenol. It delivers a high-fidelity Transparent Hold color profile (`#FFFFFF`) and leverages high-tension polymer interlocking.

dynamic_attributes.label: Usage Notes
dynamic_attributes.body: Backcomb through the brow first to coat the root, then brush upward into the desired architectural shape.

dynamic_attributes.label: Expert Tip
dynamic_attributes.body: Use the flat side of the applicator wand to press the hairs flush against the skin for a laminated effect.

dynamic_attributes.label: Formulation Insight
dynamic_attributes.body: Panthenol (Vitamin B5) prevents the high-strength polymers from causing hair breakage.
